lead: Usain Bolt is a widely followed athletics competitor, born on 21 August 1986 in Sherwood Content.
As of 2026, he is 40 years old, and his birth date places him under the Leo sign.
He has represented Racers Track Club and Central Coast Mariners FC and has been recognised with Commander of the Order of Distinction and Member of the Order of Jamaica.
Below you will find a verified overview of Usain Bolt: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

paras: His professional record lists athletics competitor as his main occupation.
